oneLiner: 导电性介于导体与绝缘体之间，掺入杂质可精确调控，是晶体管的基石。
oneLinerEn: Conductivity between conductor and insulator, tunable by doping — the basis of transistors.
detail: 导电性介于导体与绝缘体之间，掺入杂质可精确调控，是晶体管的基石。硅中掺入百万分之一的磷或硼，电阻率便下降数个数量级——“可调控”才是半导体的灵魂，导电性居中只是表象。PN 结具有单向导电性，正向导通、反向截止：二极管靠它整流，把交流变成直流；三极管再进一步，用小的基极电流控制大的集电极电流，实现放大。1947 年肖克利、巴丁与布拉顿在贝尔实验室做出锗点接触晶体管，1956 年三人同获诺贝尔奖；1958 年基尔比与 1959 年诺伊斯先后把集成电路落地——晶体管、电阻与连线做进同一块硅片。摩尔 1965 年预言集成度约每两年翻番，驱动行业把线宽从微米一路推进到纳米节点：3 纳米级工艺的栅长只相当于十几个硅原子直径（硅原子直径约 0.2 纳米），原子尺度的漏电已是必须正面处理的对手，光刻也换上了 13.5 纳米的极紫外光源。硅晶片上数十亿晶体管构成现代计算机与手机的核心。易错有二：把半导体读成“导电性居中就行”——纯净硅几乎不导电，器件性能全靠掺杂剖面；以及把“纳米节点”当真实栅长——那早已是产品代称，与实际尺寸脱钩。数字锚再补三枚：掺杂浓度常以每立方厘米 10¹⁵ 到 10¹⁸ 个计，而硅原子本身约 5×10²² 个每立方厘米——所谓“调控”就是在这上亿的宿主里安排千分之一的客子；锗管被硅管取代，因硅的禁带更宽、高温漏电更小；极紫外光源靠锡滴被激光每秒击成数十亿度的等离子体发出 13.5 纳米的光。另记一条使用边界：PN 结反向电压超过击穿值，单向导电就作废——静电击穿 CMOS 器件，走的正是这条路。
detailEn: Conductivity between conductor and insulator, tunable by doping — the basis of transistors. Doping silicon with one part per million of phosphorus or boron drops its resistivity by orders of magnitude: tunability, not middling conductivity, is the soul of a semiconductor. A PN junction conducts one way — forward on, reverse off — which makes the diode's rectifier turn AC into DC, and the bipolar transistor goes further, letting a small base current control a large collector current, that is, amplify. In 1947 Shockley, Bardeen and Brattain built the first point-contact germanium transistor at Bell Labs, sharing the 1956 Nobel Prize; Kilby (1958) and Noyce (1959) then folded transistors, resistors and wiring into a single chip. Moore's 1965 forecast — integration doubling roughly every two years — drove lithography from microns down to nanometre-class nodes: a 3 nm gate spans only a dozen or so silicon atom diameters (about 0.2 nm each), so atomic-scale leakage is an opponent you must face head-on, and the patterning light itself has become 13.5 nm extreme ultraviolet. Billions of transistors on silicon wafers power computers and phones. Two traps: calling a semiconductor “just middling conductors” — pure silicon barely conducts, and devices live on doping profiles — and reading “nanometre node” as a real gate length, a product label long detached from physical gate dimensions. Three more anchors: doping runs at roughly 10¹⁵ to 10¹⁸ atoms per cubic centimetre against silicon's own 5×10²² — “tuning” means seating a thousandth of guests among a hundred-billion hosts; germanium yielded to silicon because silicon's wider bandgap leaks less when hot; and the 13.5 nm extreme-ultraviolet light itself comes from tin droplets vaporised into billion-degree plasma by lasers, fifty thousand times a second. One boundary to respect: reverse a PN junction past its breakdown voltage and the one-way traffic dies — that is exactly how static electricity kills a chip.

oneLiner: 某些材料降到临界温度以下电阻突降为零并完全抗磁。
oneLinerEn: Below a critical temperature some materials drop to zero resistance and expel magnetic fields.
detail: 某些材料降到临界温度以下电阻突降为零并完全抗磁。1911 年昂内斯把汞冷却到 4.2 开尔文附近，电阻表突然读不出任何数值——零电阻不是“很小”，而是“没有”。但超导态有三把门槛：温度、磁场与电流各超过临界值都会把它打断，磁体绕制时必须三者都留余量。迈斯纳效应是它的第二重身份：超导体把内部磁通完全排出，体现完全抗磁性——这不能从零电阻推出，零电阻只“冻结”既有磁通，抗磁才是独立假设，也是磁悬浮列车与超导轴承的原理（上海演示线与日本 L0 系磁悬浮列车时速 603 公里皆赖强磁体）。应用按冷却代价分两营：液氦温区（4.2 开尔文）的低温超导做 MRI 与加速器磁体；1986 年以后的钇钡铜氧一类铜氧化物把临界温度推到 90 开尔文上下、越过 77 开尔文的液氮沸点——液氮便宜一个数量级，“高温超导”四个字只相对 4.2 开尔文而言，离室温仍远。约瑟夫森效应让超导结在电压下产生频率严格正比于电压的振荡（约 483.6 兆赫兹每微伏），电压基准至今由约瑟夫森结阵列复现。零电阻可实现无损耗输电、强磁体；高温超导仍在攻关。易错：把“完全抗磁”当“零电阻的推论”，以及以为超导体在任何磁场下都能悬浮——超过临界磁场，悬浮立刻塌掉。数字锚再补三枚：磁场并非在界面“硬切”，而是渗入表面几十到几百纳米后才衰减到零，这个穿透深度是第二类超导体涡旋活动的舞台；2019 千克重定义复现所用的基布尔秤，靠的正是超导磁体把力学量与电学量锁在天平两端；超导环里的持续电流实测可十年以上不见衰减，“零电阻”不是修辞。工程账也要算：制冷能耗常常高于线路损耗的节省，超导电缆在电网改造中经济性仍排在铜铝之后。
detailEn: Below a critical temperature some materials drop to zero resistance and expel magnetic fields. In 1911 Onnes cooled mercury near 4.2 K and the ohmmeter could find no value at all — zero resistance is not “very small,” it is “none.” But the superconducting state stands behind three gates: temperature, magnetic field and current each carry a critical value beyond which superconductivity snaps, and magnet designers keep margin on all three. The Meissner effect is its second identity: a superconductor expels interior flux, showing perfect diamagnetism — a fact not derivable from zero resistance, which merely freezes whatever flux is already there. That independent axiom is what lifts maglev trains (Japan's L0 Series at 603 km/h) and bearings. Applications split by cooling cost: liquid-helium low-temperature superconductors (4.2 K) build MRI and accelerator magnets, while the copper oxides since 1986 — yttrium barium copper oxide among them — push the critical temperature near 90 K, above liquid nitrogen's 77 K boiling point, a tenth the price; “high-Tc” is high only against 4.2 K, still far from room temperature. The Josephson effect makes a superconducting junction oscillate at a frequency strictly proportional to voltage (about 483.6 MHz per microvolt), and the volt is still reproduced from Josephson arrays today. Zero resistance enables lossless power and strong magnets; room-temperature superconductivity remains the open goal. Two traps: treating perfect diamagnetism as a corollary of zero resistance, and assuming a superconductor levitates in any field — past the critical field the levitation collapses. Three more anchors: the field is not guillotined at the surface but decays over tens to hundreds of nanometres of penetration depth — the stage on which type-II superconductors host their vortex activity; the Kibble balance used in the 2019 kilogram reproduction leans on superconducting magnets to lock mechanical and electrical quantities on one beam; and persistent currents in a superconducting loop are measured to persist a decade or more without decay — “zero resistance” is not rhetoric. The engineering ledger matters too: refrigeration often costs more than the line loss it saves, which is why superconducting cable still ranks behind copper and aluminium in grid upgrades.

oneLiner: 受激辐射放大产生方向性好、单色度高、亮度极强的人造光。
oneLinerEn: Light amplified by stimulated emission — highly directional, monochromatic and intense.
detail: 受激辐射放大产生方向性好、单色度高、亮度极强的人造光。热平衡下低能态的原子总是多于高能态，受激辐射敌不过吸收，所以造激光第一步是“泵浦”把工作物质抽成粒子数反转——高能态原子多于低能态，放大才能压过吸收；这一步 1917 年由爱因斯坦的受激辐射理论埋下地基。第二步是谐振腔：两面反射镜让光往返穿越增益介质，同频率、同方向、同相位的光在受激辐射中复制壮大。1960 年梅曼的红宝石激光器打出第一束。单色性与方向性可以量化：氦氖激光 632.8 纳米的红光谱线宽可窄到 10⁻⁵ 纳米量级，单色比约千万分之一，而钠黄光 589.0 纳米的谱线宽约 6×10⁻⁴ 纳米；激光发散角约 1 毫弧度，10 米外光斑仍只有厘米级、1 千米外约 1 米，探照灯在百米外已铺开近 9 米的弥散斑。光盘读出激光从 CD 的 780 纳米走到蓝光的 405 纳米，波长越短可刻的凹点越小、容量越大；眼科手术用准分子激光以每次约十纳米的厚度逐层消融角膜。2022 年 12 月美国国家点火装置近两百路激光同击毫米级靶丸，聚变输出首超入射激光能量。光纤通信、精密切割、激光雷达、条码扫描皆源于此。易错：把“激光天然单色”当无条件事实——单色性取决于腔与谱线，以及把激光的危险只想到功率——连续激光伤眼靠亮度，脉冲激光伤眼靠能量密度。数字锚再补三枚：一支 1 毫瓦氦氖激光的发散角约 1 毫弧度，折算亮度足以与太阳表面比肩——“亮过太阳”不是夸张而是发散角换来的事实；激光雷达选 1550 纳米而非 905 纳米，因前者被角膜吸收、到不了视网膜，人眼安全功率高一个数量级；核聚变点火路线中，起爆的“点数”靠黑腔内 X 射线均匀重定向，激光本身并不直接加热燃料。
detailEn: Light amplified by stimulated emission — highly directional, monochromatic and intense. In thermal equilibrium the lower level always outnumbers the upper, so absorption beats stimulated emission; the first move of any laser is to pump the gain medium into population inversion, where more atoms sit up than down and amplification can win. Einstein laid that theoretical ground in 1917. The second move is the resonator: two mirrors bounce light through the medium again and again while stimulated emission clones waves of one frequency, one direction, one phase. Maiman's ruby laser fired the first beam in 1960. Monochromaticity and direction can be quantified: a helium-neon laser at 632.8 nm can have a linewidth near 10⁻⁵ nm — a monochromaticity ratio of about one in seventy million — versus roughly 6×10⁻⁴ nm for the 589.0 nm sodium D line; a laser diverges by about 1 milliradian, its spot still centimetres wide at 10 m and about a metre at 1 km, where a searchlight already smears to nearly 9 m at 100 m. Disc readout lasers walked from CD's 780 nm to Blu-ray's 405 nm — the shorter the wavelength, the smaller the pit and the larger the capacity; excimer lasers shave the cornea in steps of about ten nanometres per pulse for eye surgery. In December 2022 the National Ignition Facility's nearly two hundred beams struck a millimetre target and fusion output exceeded the incoming laser energy for the first time. Fiber optics, precision cutting, LIDAR and barcode scanning all descend from this. Two traps: treating “lasers are monochromatic” as unconditional — it depends on cavity and line — and thinking only power makes lasers dangerous: continuous beams injure by brightness, pulsed beams by energy density. Three more anchors: a 1 mW helium-neon beam diverging by ~1 mrad reaches a brightness comparable to the sun's surface — “brighter than the sun” is arithmetic bought with divergence, not hype; LIDAR for the road chooses 1550 nm over 905 nm because the former is absorbed by the cornea and never reaches the retina, lifting the eye-safe power budget an order of magnitude; and in ignition experiments the laser does not heat the fuel directly — a hohlraum converts the beams to a uniform X-ray bath that squeezes the pellet.

oneLiner: 核裂变与核聚变释放巨大能量，是重要的高效能源。
oneLinerEn: Fission and fusion release vast energy — potent power sources.
detail: 核裂变与核聚变释放巨大能量，是重要的高效能源。链式反应靠中子维系：铀-235 裂变放出两三个中子，慢化剂把快中子减速成更易引发裂变的慢中子（石墨、重水皆可胜任），控制棒吸收中子决定反应速率——两者配合让堆芯处于“刚好自持”的临界状态，控制棒全部插入即停堆；1942 年费米团队在芝加哥大学球场看台下让 CP-1 达到临界，输出功率只有半个瓦。能量密度是核能的名片：1 千克铀-235 完全裂变约释放 8.2×10¹³ 焦，折近三万吨标准煤——一座百万千瓦机组每天“烧”掉的铀以克计。工程屏障层层设防：压水堆把一回路加压到约 150 个大气压，三百多度的水仍不沸腾，热量经二回路变成蒸汽推汽轮机；安全壳拦住放射性物质的最后一道去向。代价写在事故与废料账上：1979 年三里岛、1986 年切尔诺贝利、2011 年福岛；乏燃料里的长寿命核素需要万年尺度的隔离处置，而正常运行下核电站几乎不排碳。核电站用可控裂变链式反应发电；太阳与氢弹靠聚变；可控聚变（“人造太阳”）因清洁、原料丰富而被寄予厚望。易错有二：把链式反应当“燃烧”——它不需要氧，“灭火”直觉在这里失效；以及担心反应堆“像原子弹那样炸”——燃料铀-235 浓度只有百分之几，与武器级的九成以上差着量级，物理上不可能核爆。数字锚再补三枚：全球在运核电机组四百余台、供全程发电量约百分之九，法国比例约六成半；轻水堆对天然铀中铀-235 的利用率不足百分之一，快堆与循环工艺的目标正是把这笔账翻过来；停堆一小时堆芯仍有约百分之七的功率在衰变发热——三里岛与福岛的熔毁都发生在这份“关不掉的余热”上，泵停止循环比链式反应停止更难。
detailEn: Fission and fusion release vast energy — potent power sources. A chain reaction runs on neutrons: each fission of uranium-235 frees two or three, a moderator (graphite or heavy water) slows them into the easy-to-capture slow band, and control rods absorb them to set the rate — together they hold the core at the edge of criticality, and flooding the rods stops the reactor. In 1942 Fermi's team brought Chicago Pile-1 critical under a football stadium's bleachers at half a watt. Energy density is nuclear power's calling card: a kilogram of uranium-235, fully fissioned, yields about 8.2×10¹³ J, close to thirty thousand tonnes of standard coal — a gigawatt-class plant burns grams of fuel per day. Engineering layers stand between the core and the world: a pressurized-water reactor keeps its primary loop at some 150 atmospheres so water at over 300 °C still does not boil, handing heat to a secondary loop whose steam turns the turbine, while the containment vessel is the last barrier for radioactivity. The bill comes due in accidents and waste: Three Mile Island in 1979, Chernobyl in 1986, Fukushima in 2011; long-lived nuclides in spent fuel need ten-thousand-year isolation, though routine operation emits almost no carbon. Reactors run controlled fission; the Sun and bombs use fusion; controlled fusion (“artificial suns”) is prized for clean, abundant fuel. Two traps: reading the chain reaction as “burning” — it needs no oxygen, and firefighting intuition fails here — and fearing a reactor will “explode like a bomb”: reactor fuel sits at a few percent uranium-235 against weapons-grade ninety-plus, a gap that makes nuclear detonation physically impossible. Three more anchors: some 440 reactors supply about nine percent of world electricity, France leaning on the option for roughly two-thirds; light-water reactors burn under one percent of natural uranium's U-235, and fast reactors plus reprocessing exist to flip that ledger; and one hour after shutdown the core still releases about seven percent of its operating power as decay heat — the meltdowns at Three Mile Island and Fukushima both happened on this “heat you cannot switch off,” which is why losing circulation, not losing the chain reaction, is the true emergency.

oneLiner: 无线电波到射线构成电磁波谱，不同波段各有应用。
oneLinerEn: From radio to gamma rays, each band has its uses.
detail: 无线电波到 γ 射线构成电磁波谱，不同波段各有应用。谱系按波长从千米级排到 10 皮米量级的 γ 射线，跨十几个数量级；分界不在“波的名字”，而在光子能量 E=hf——频率相差十个数量级，作用机制便各不相同。微波 2.45 吉赫兹对应波长约 12 厘米，通信与雷达的好地段；红外线对应分子热运动，人体 310 开尔文的辐射峰值在约 10 微米波段，热成像相机因此“看得见温度”，遥控器则用近红外的发光二极管对准接收窗。可见光只占谱上一窄条；紫外线里 200 到 280 纳米的短波成分破坏微生物的复制机制，用于杀菌，同一类高能量光子打在皮肤上就是晒伤。X 射线凭穿透本领成像：软组织透过多、骨骼吸收多，医学剂量以毫西弗计量，CT 一次约 10 毫西弗；γ 射线用于放疗与金属探伤。无线电用于通信广播，微波用于雷达与加热，红外线遥感与热成像，可见光是视觉，紫外线杀菌，X 射线成像，γ 射线治疗与探伤。易错有二：把“辐射”一律当“电离辐射”——红外、微波光子能量不足，只能加热、不能打断化学键；以及坚持“微波炉靠水共振”的旧谣言——2.45 吉赫兹并不是水的固有频率，加热靠的是电场驱使极性分子来回转向、彼此碰撞生热。数字锚再补三枚：可见光只占 400 到 700 纳米一窄条，其两侧紫外与红外的“化学效应”分野早在 1800 年由赫歇尔用温度计探红外、1801 年里特用氯化银探紫外先后发现；紫外线再按波长分 UV-A、UV-B、UV-C 三段，臭氧层截掉波长最短的 UV-C，晒伤主要由 UV-B 承担；家用 Wifi 与微波炉同在 2.45 吉赫兹挤一个频段，互扰的根源正在这里——波段应用史半部是频谱争夺史。
detailEn: From radio to gamma rays, each band has its uses. The spectrum runs from kilometre-scale radio waves down to gamma rays near 10 picometres, spanning well over a decade of orders; the true boundary is not the band's name but the photon energy E = hf — separated by ten powers of frequency, the mechanisms differ utterly. Microwaves at 2.45 GHz correspond to about 12 cm, a good address for radar and links. Infrared matches molecular vibration: a body at 310 K radiates peaking near 10 µm, which is why thermal cameras “see temperature,” while remotes aim a near-infrared LED at the receiver. Visible light is a thin sliver. In the ultraviolet, the 200–280 nm band scrambles microbial reproduction and sterilizes surfaces — the same kind of energetic photon reaching skin is a sunburn. X-rays image by penetration differences: soft tissue transmits, bone absorbs; medical doses are counted in millisieverts, a CT round about 10. Gamma rays treat tumours and probe steel for flaws. Radio for comms, microwaves for radar and heating, infrared for remote sensing, visible for sight, UV for sterilizing, X-rays for imaging, gamma for therapy and inspection. Two traps: treating every “radiation” as ionizing — infrared and microwave photons cannot break chemical bonds, only heat — and keeping the old rumor that microwave ovens run on water resonance: 2.45 GHz is not water's natural frequency; the field twists polar molecules back and forth and collisions do the heating. Three more anchors: visible light is a sliver from 400 to 700 nm, and the infrared and ultraviolet sides were found within a year of each other — Herschel with a thermometer in 1800, Ritter with silver chloride in 1801; the ultraviolet splits into UV-A, UV-B and UV-C, the ozone layer screens out the shortest band, and sunburn is mostly UV-B's signature; and household Wifi shares the 2.45 GHz microwave band with the oven next door — half the history of spectrum applications is a history of spectrum fights.

oneLiner: 让光在玻璃纤维中全反射长途奔流，承载现代互联网的信息洪流。
oneLinerEn: Light races by total internal reflection through glass fibers, carrying the flood of modern internet data.
detail: 让光在玻璃纤维中全反射长途奔流，承载现代互联网的信息洪流。全反射把条件做得极温和：纤芯折射率约 1.46、包层约 1.45，掠射在芯层界面的光几乎全部反射回芯内，折射率只差 0.01 便足够锁光；临界角约 83 度，意味着即便光纤弯折，沿轴向前进的光仍一根不断地传输。1966 年高锟指出玻璃纤维的损耗源于杂质而非玻璃本性，把衰减压到 20 分贝每千米以下通信即属可行——他因此获 2009 年诺贝尔物理学奖。数字对比最能说明进步：早年劣质玻璃 50 千米便只剩百分之一的光，今天的石英光纤在 1550 纳米的最低损耗窗口只有约 0.15 分贝每千米，光跑完 100 千米还剩下约百分之三，理论极限更在 0.02 分贝以下。中继器与掺铒光纤放大器在洋底接力补光，总长百万千米级的海底光缆网承载洲际通信，一对光纤可同时奔流数十太比特每秒的话务。利用光的全反射把信号锁在纤芯内几乎无损地传输，一条光纤可同时传送海量通话与网络数据，构成全球通信的骨干。易错有二：把光纤当“镜子管子”——光走的不是镜面直线反射而是掠射全反射的折线，包层既是反射面也是保护，不可省略；以及把“光速在纤芯里仍是 c”当真——纤芯中光速约降到真空的三分之二，色散与延迟都由此来。数字锚再补三枚：纤芯直径单模约 9 微米、多模约 50 微米，包层统一 125 微米、涂覆层 250 微米——“头发丝”并非修辞；一根光纤里用波分复用可并行上百个波长，每个波长各自奔流百吉比特，容量靠“颜色分车道”而非单声道提速；1550 纳米窗口的光在组织般介质里早被吸收殆尽，而它在石英里能跑百公里——同一种光，两个世界。
detailEn: Light races by total internal reflection through glass fibers, carrying the flood of modern internet data. The fiber makes the grazing condition gentle: a core of index about 1.46 sheathed in cladding of about 1.45 — a difference of just 0.01 is enough to lock light inside, with a critical angle near 83°, so even a bent fiber keeps axially travelling light hopping along without escape. In 1966 Kao showed the loss of glass fibre came from impurities rather than glass itself, and that pushing attenuation below 20 dB per kilometre would make communication feasible — the 2009 Nobel Prize followed. Numbers tell the progress: poor early glass left one percent of the light after 50 km, while today's silica fiber in its 1550 nm loss window runs at about 0.15 dB per kilometre, still around three percent remaining after 100 km, with a theoretical floor below 0.02. Repeaters and erbium-doped fiber amplifiers relight the signal across ocean floors, and a subsea network measured in millions of kilometres interconnects continents, tens of terabits per second flowing through a single fiber pair. Total internal reflection traps the signal in the core with little loss; one fiber carries vast simultaneous voice and data traffic — the backbone of global communication. Two traps: picturing the fiber as a “mirror pipe” — the ray advances by grazing total reflections, not mirror bounces, and the cladding is both reflector and protector — and assuming light inside still moves at c: in the core it runs at about two thirds of vacuum speed, which is where delay and dispersion come from. Three more anchors: cores run 9 µm single-mode or 50 µm multi-mode inside a standard 125 µm cladding and 250 µm coating — “human hair” is specification, not metaphor; wavelength-division multiplexing runs a hundred-plus colours down one fiber, each carrying a hundred gigabits, capacity built by lane-splitting rather than a single louder channel; and 1550 nm light that is swallowed almost immediately by tissue will cross a hundred kilometres of silica — same photon, two worlds.

oneLiner: 用强磁场与无线电波让人体内的氢原子发出信号，绘制无损的软组织图像。
oneLinerEn: Strong fields and radio waves make body hydrogen emit signals, painting soft-tissue images without radiation.
detail: 用强磁场与无线电波让人体内的氢原子发出信号，绘制无损的软组织图像。水与脂肪多氢，人体是天然的样品池。质子在磁场里以约 42.58 兆赫每特斯拉的比率进动，1.5 特斯拉的扫描仪对应约 64 兆赫射频脉冲——恰好落在无线电波段，MRI 发射与接收的都是无线电波。射频脉冲撤去后，氢核回到平衡态放出回波；梯度磁场按位置给频率编码，T1、T2 两种弛豫时间在不同组织间差异明显，对比度由此而来，脑与关节等软组织图像因此清晰。场强标尺可比：地磁场只有约 50 微特斯拉，医院常用的 1.5 与 3 特斯拉比它强三到六万倍，7 特斯拉科研机也已用于人体成像。因不含电离辐射，它特别适合观察软组织；但强磁场对铁磁性金属与心脏起搏器植入者是禁区，铁磁性异物在 1.5 特斯拉场中受力可相当于自重的百倍量级，检查前的金属筛查不是形式主义；造影剂钆用于增强病灶显影。氢核在磁场中按特定频率共振，撤去脉冲后回波被接收并重建为断层图像。易错有二：把“核磁共振”的“核”当放射性核——它是氢原子核，与放射无关；以及把“特斯拉”当能量单位——那是磁感应强度单位，MRI 说的是场强不是剂量。数字锚再补三枚：3 特斯拉对应约 127.7 兆赫，频率越高在组织里波长越短、射频场越难打匀，高场的均匀性与比吸收率（发热）限值是一对硬约束；把质子自旋翻转所需的能量折成温度只有毫开量级，信号之微弱可见一斑，这也是 MRI 线圈要紧贴人体那么近的原因；7 特斯拉机型已获批人体成像，而它的磁场仍抓不住一枚硬币——磁场力作用在铁磁体上才粗暴，对水分子只是轻轻扶正。
detailEn: Strong fields and radio waves make body hydrogen emit signals, painting soft-tissue images without radiation. Water and fat are full of hydrogen, and a human body is a ready sample. Protons precess at about 42.58 MHz per tesla, so a 1.5 T scanner speaks to them at roughly 64 MHz of RF — squarely in the radio band; an MRI machine transmits and receives radio waves. After the pulse stops, nuclei relax back and return echoes; gradient fields tag position with frequency, and the two relaxation times T1 and T2 differ enough between tissues to build the contrast that makes brain and joints legible. For scale, Earth's field is about 50 microtesla — the clinic's 1.5 T and 3 T run thirty to sixty thousand times stronger, and 7 T research machines already image people. Free of ionizing radiation, it excels at soft tissue; but the field itself is the hazard: ferromagnetic objects and some pacemakers are barred, a loose ferromagnetic tool can feel forces hundreds of times its weight in a 1.5 T bore, so metal screening is not ceremony, and gadolinium contrast agents sharpen lesions. Hydrogen nuclei resonate at a set frequency in the field and their echoes are rebuilt into slices. Two traps: reading the “nuclear” in nuclear magnetic resonance as radioactivity — it means the hydrogen nucleus — and treating “tesla” as a dose unit: it measures field strength, not energy deposited. Three more anchors: 3 T corresponds to about 127.7 MHz, and the higher the frequency the shorter the wavelength inside tissue and the harder the RF is to distribute evenly — field uniformity and the specific absorption rate (heating) are the twin constraints at high field; the energy difference between proton spin states, converted to temperature, is in millikelvin order, which is how faint the signal is and why the coil must hug the body; and 7 T machines are approved for human imaging yet still cannot pick up a coin — magnetic force is brutal only on ferromagnets; on water it merely straightens the posture.

oneLiner: 用电磁场把微观粒子加速到近光速并对撞，揭示物质最深处的结构。
oneLinerEn: Electric and magnetic fields drive particles near light speed and smash them, probing matter's innermost structure.
detail: 用电磁场把微观粒子加速到近光速并对撞，揭示物质最深处的结构。原理分工明确：电场每过一道缝隙加速一次，磁场只做偏转与聚焦、对粒子不做功。1932 年劳伦斯发明回旋加速器，恒定磁场里粒子沿螺旋一路提速；能量再高，相对论效应让转速失同步，于是有同步加速器与对撞机——两束反向环流，把能量全部押在对心上而不是浪费在撞静止靶。1988 年北京正负电子对撞机建成，τ 轻子质量等测量随之更新世界平均值。大型强子对撞机周长 26.7 公里，质子每秒环行约 1.1 万圈；6.5 太电子伏的质子洛伦兹因子约七千，只比光速慢每秒 3 米；束流由 8.3 特斯拉的超导磁体箍在轨道内，整条环路泡在 1.9 开尔文的超流氦里——比 2.7 开尔文的外太空更冷，是人类最大的低温工程。13.6 太电子伏的对撞能量换来了 2012 年希格斯玻色子的确认。加速器家族如今半数在医院：质子与重离子治疗用布拉格峰把剂量砸进肿瘤而非穿体而过，医用同位素靠回旋加速器量产；弯道的同步辐射从“干扰手段”翻身成“超级显微镜”。易错有二：以为对撞机是“显微镜换代”——其实是能量换尺度，由德布罗意关系，束流物质波比可见光短十几个数量级；以及以为磁场也在加速——磁场只改方向不做功，提速的永远只有电场。数字锚再补三枚：全球加速器实数以万计，其中过半在医院——CT 与闪光刀的 X 射线管、电子束保鲜、放疗直线加速器都是它的亲戚，对撞机只是家族里最贵的那一支；27 公里的周长不是想要多大建多大，而是沿用 1988 年退役的莱普大隧道——能量被地基预算锁死；同步辐射亮度比常规 X 射线管高千万倍量级，蛋白质晶体学、锂电池充放电原位观察都靠它。
detailEn: Electric and magnetic fields drive particles near light speed and smash them, probing matter's innermost structure. The division of labour is strict: electric fields kick across every gap, magnetic fields only bend and focus, doing no work. Lawrence's 1932 cyclotron spiralled particles up inside a fixed field; at higher energies relativity detunes the spin, so synchrotrons and colliders took over — two counter-rotating beams betting all their energy on the collision instead of wasting most of it on a stationary target. Beijing's electron-positron collider, completed in 1988, refined world-average measurements such as the tau lepton mass. The Large Hadron Collider rings at 26.7 km: protons lap about eleven thousand times a second; at 6.5 TeV each proton's Lorentz factor nears seven thousand, putting it a mere three metres per second under c; 8.3 tesla superconducting magnets clamp the beams, and the whole loop bathes in superfluid helium at 1.9 K — colder than interplanetary space's 2.7 K, the largest cryogenic plant ever built. The 13.6 TeV collision energy paid for the Higgs boson in 2012. Half the accelerator family now lives in hospitals: proton and heavy-ion therapy banks dose in a Bragg peak inside the tumour instead of passing through, and medical isotopes are mass-made in cyclotrons, while the synchrotron radiation once cursed as a leak has been rehired as a “super microscope.” Two traps: calling a collider a microscope upgrade — it trades energy for resolution, since beam matter waves run ten-plus orders shorter than visible light — and crediting magnets with acceleration: they turn, never push. Three more anchors: accelerators number in the tens of thousands worldwide and more than half work in hospitals — the X-ray tubes behind CT and radiosurgery, electron-beam sterilisation and linac therapy are all family members; the collider is merely the most expensive branch; the LHC's 27 km is not ambition but inheritance, the ring reused from the LEP tunnel retired in 1988 — energy priced by civil engineering; and synchrotron light runs some ten million times brighter than a conventional X-ray tube, which is how protein crystallography and in-operando battery studies got their microscope.

oneLiner: 利用量子叠加与纠缠并行探索答案，在特定问题上远超经典计算机。
oneLinerEn: Exploiting superposition and entanglement to explore answers in parallel, far outpacing classical machines on select problems.
detail: 利用量子叠加与纠缠并行探索答案，在特定问题上远超经典计算机。经典比特非 0 即 1，量子比特在测量前处于 0 与 1 的叠加；n 比特的状态空间按 2ⁿ 膨胀，50 比特对应约 1.1×10¹⁵ 个振幅——需要同时存储的天文数字正是量子算法的杠杆。1994 年秀尔给出因数分解的量子算法：大数分解对经典计算机是指数量级的难题，RSA 一类公钥密码正立在它之上，“破解密码”因此成为量子计算最早的名声，也是后量子密码学立项的原因。路线竞争看物理实现：超导回路、离子阱、光量子各据一角。2019 年谷歌以 53 比特超导处理器宣布“量子霸权”——其 200 秒完成的采样任务，最强超算估计要一万年；2020 年“九章”光量子原型机在高斯玻色采样上把优势拉到百亿亿倍量级，“祖冲之”系列则接续超导路线。与叠加原理同源的量子通信早已实用：1984 年的 BB84 协议保证窃听必留痕，2016 年“墨子号”卫星实现千公里级星地密钥分发。量子比特可同时处于零与一的叠加，多比特纠缠令状态空间指数膨胀，在因数分解、模拟分子等任务上潜力巨大。易错有二：“叠加”不等于“同时算出所有答案然后读取”——测量只能取回一个结果，算力来自让错误答案相消、正确答案相长的干涉设计；真正的拦路虎是退相干——超导量子比特相干时间仅百微秒量级，纠错要靠上千物理比特换一逻辑比特，离通用普及尚远。数字锚再补三枚：谷歌 2019 年的声明随即遭 IBM 质疑——同样的采样任务用优化过的经典算法在萨米特超算上约两天可完成，“一万年”只是朴素估法，基准之争本身就是这个领域的日常；超导路线的芯片活在稀释制冷机约 15 毫开的环境里，比星际空间冷千倍，而光量子路线在室温就能跑——制冷的账也是路线之争的账；目前纠错靠上千个物理比特换一个可靠逻辑比特，工程门槛仍以“数量级”计。
detailEn: Exploiting superposition and entanglement to explore answers in parallel, far outpacing classical machines on select problems. A classical bit is 0 or 1; a qubit, before measurement, rides a blend of both, and an n-bit system's state space grows as 2ⁿ — fifty qubits mean roughly 1.1×10¹⁵ amplitudes to hold at once, and that astronomical ledger is the leverage quantum algorithms spend. In 1994 Shor gave a quantum algorithm for factoring: big-number factorisation is an exponential grind for classical machines, RSA-style public-key cryptography stands on that difficulty, and “breaking codes” became quantum computing's earliest reputation — and the reason post-quantum cryptography was chartered. The race over physical implementation splits among superconducting circuits, ion traps and photonics. Google's 2019 53-qubit announcement of “quantum supremacy” cited 200 seconds of sampling that the strongest supercomputer might take ten thousand years for; China's Jiuzhang photonic prototype stretched the advantage in Gaussian boson sampling to the exafold scale in 2020, while the Zuchongzhi line pressed on superconducting. Quantum communication, a sibling of the same physics, is already operational: the 1984 BB84 protocol guarantees eavesdroppers leave marks, and the 2016 Micius satellite distributed keys over more than a thousand kilometres between ground and orbit. A qubit holds a blend of zero and one at once, and entangling many grows the state space exponentially — huge promise for factoring and simulating molecules. Two traps: “superposition” is not “compute all answers and read them out” — measurement returns a single result, and the power comes from interference that cancels wrong answers and compounds right ones; and the real gatekeeper is decoherence — superconducting qubits hold coherence for only hundreds of microseconds, fault tolerance spends a thousand physical bits per logical one, and general-purpose machines remain far off. Three more anchors: IBM immediately contested Google's 2019 claim, estimating the same sampling task at roughly two days on an optimised classical Summit run — the “ten thousand years” was the naive baseline, and benchmark disputes are this field's daily weather; superconducting qubits live inside dilution refrigerators near 15 millikelvin, a thousand times colder than interstellar space, while photonic qubits run at room temperature — the refrigeration bill is itself part of the route war; and today's error correction still spends a thousand-plus physical qubits per reliable logical one, so the engineering threshold is measured in orders of magnitude.
